title: Oddkin check results v1
description: Runs of the checks change impact selects (change-impact-and-verification.md §2.4): one result per run of a check, for example per browser, and the commit the runs happened at. oddkin-impact compare reads them with --results (runs to merge into a report) and --baseline (earlier runs to reuse).

source.description: Where every run in the file happened: the commit, and whether the working tree had changes it does not hold. A baseline result is reused only from the base snapshot's own commit with neither side dirty. Absent when not recorded.

check.description: The check's id in the impact report: example:<tag>/<name> or suite:<id>#<tag>.

product.description: The product the check ran in, when it ran in one.

state.description: not-executed: selected but not run (skipped, filtered, or the environment was unavailable).

message.description: Why it failed or did not run.

conditions.description: What ran: browser and version, configuration, input hashes.
